authorization: Step 2.2 only. Run N0/N1/P (never A). No 18-task full pilot, no Step 3.
candidates: 12 (retail T1 25/62/65, T2 0/1/2; airline T1 2/3/4, T2 7/8/11). Selection: official scorer + task type (info-only=T1 / mutation=T2). Eligibility decided by neutral/P probe, NOT gold-action length.
junction: natural information-gated. T1: agent requests a required fact before substantive tool work (reads_done==0) -> that request is the junction; branch reply supplies the identical fact. T2: natural confirmation node, evidence gathered, confirmation+mutation not yet done -> mutation lands in suffix.

branches.N1: natural neutral reply supplying the same fact/decision x5
branches.P: N1 + explicit task-legal extra process step x5

eligibility.baseline_competence: N1 official reward==1 in >=4/5 runs; DB and COMMUNICATE components readable
eligibility.suffix_exposure: T1: N1 suffix has >=2 real tool calls in >=4/5 runs; T2: real mutation in N1 suffix in >=4/5 runs; process after junction
eligibility.reproducibility: active N0 primary-metric range <=1; snapshot/prefix/state hash identical
eligibility.positive_control: P moves primary metric in frozen direction in >=3/5 runs; P vs N1 endpoint reward within tolerance; not merely 0->any

eligibility_source: N0/N1/P only. A is never inspected.
min_gate_to_proceed: eligible cells >=8; >=6 tasks; both retail+airline; both T1+T2; >=2 models; >=90% active-N0 range<=1; scorer 100% non-None; dual review closed.
serving: online vLLM, concurrency=1, fixed served-name/parser; Mistral empty-tool-name fail-closed. Offline deterministic mode unavailable (co-tenant GPU); batch-invariance caveat recorded.
review: two independent one-shot LOCAL review jobs on different vLLM endpoints (not interactive sub-agents). disagreement fail-closed. dual-independent-agent review, NOT human-validated.
